findings.title: manifest and cleanup exact set omit retained final raw stream
evidence: trust_chain/manifest.json outputs has raw/static_json_validation_r1.stdout.raw but not raw/static_json_validation_r1_final.stdout.raw
trust_chain/cleanup_inventory.json owned_products/final_exact_owned_set name only the first raw
trust_chain/validation_receipt.json raw and current_artifact_sha256 include both raw streams
trust_chain/ directory actual file count is 9
findings.impact: The final validator evidence is not losslessly represented by the declared handoff/cleanup set; manifest-driven cleanup or ingestion could omit it.
findings.required_action: Add raw/static_json_validation_r1_final.stdout.raw to outputs, owned_products and final_exact_owned_set, then recompute dependent hashes and rerun independent review.

positive_checks: 11 absence IDs are exact and lossless
canonical fingerprint recomputes exactly over the complete register
revocation unavailable is typed_absence/terminal_deferred/no_publish and distinct from fail_closed
Stage 0/1 digest and scope/source binding precede path construction
six HEAD owners and three AD56 dirty executors have exact paths, SHA-256 and OIDs
TEST_ONLY profile cannot be production and production profile remains typed_absent
authority enum is closed and unknown values fail_closed
raw byte counts and SHA-256 values match receipts
